verdict.rationale: turbopuffer documents its own query filtering. Vector search is "combined with any filters", kNN runs "over a filtered subset", regex matching uses trigram indexes, patch and delete work by filter, and attributes can be marked filterable. The permissions guide also implies membership-style filtering, since it filters on per-document `group_ids`. However, the pack never shows the specific operators the story names, so the depth of filter expressiveness is unproven. missing for 10: documented range operators, geo filtering, nested boolean (And/Or/Not) composition, explicit array-membership operators, and independent or hands-on corroboration of filter richness.
